description: This file defines a singleton class `VoiceWakeGlobalSettingsSync` responsible for synchronizing voice wake trigger settings with a remote gateway. It manages subscriptions, refreshes state, and handles updates related to voice wake triggers within the application. The class uses async/await patterns, logging, and interacts with external connection and state management components.

classes.name: VoiceWakeGlobalSettingsSync
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the synchronization of voice wake trigger settings with an external gateway, handling updates and stream subscriptions asynchronously.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the background task that periodically refreshes and subscribes to updates from the gateway.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the ongoing background task for synchronization.

methods.name: refreshFromGateway
methods.description: Fetches the latest voice wake triggers from the gateway and applies them to the app state.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming push events to update voice wake triggers when a relevant event occurs.
